data.name: Basketball Reservation
data.headline: Resort Guests Only | Complimentary
data.description:
Enjoy a game of basketball and shoot some hoops under our tropical palms. 

**Reservation is required** 
________________________________
data.itinerary: Availble daily between the hours of 8AM - 6PM
data.what_is_included: Basketball and basketball court are included for the hour reserved of rental.
data.what_is_not_included: Water is not included; bringing your own water bottle is highly recommended.
data.what_to_bring: Must be 16 years or older to checkout equipment and a valid Driver's License or ID is required while equipment is in use.
data.cancellation_summary: Please email the Recreation Department at recreation@paradisepoint.com to inform us of your cancellation.
data.cancellation_notes:
Cancellations made at least 24 hours in advance are eligible for a full refund or credit. If we need to cancel your reservation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances, you will also receive a full refund or credit.

**To cancel or inquire about your reservation, please contact us by phone 619-247-9345**. No-shows and cancellations made within 24 hours of the reservation will be charged in full.
data.booking_notes:
You're all set. Please head to the Island Market during your designated time slot to pickup your equipment. 

Please note, you will need to leave a valid drivers license or ID when using the Resort equipment.

To cancel, please respond to this email stating you wish to cancel.
data.check_in_details:
Staff will be at the **Island Market** on the hour sharp to hand out equipment.

**Reservation is required** 

**Please note we will wait 10 minutes before you forfeit your reservation and it will be cancelled.**
